Naomi / team — quick internal playbook notes (pulled from recent similar wins):

Proposal we can move quickly on this week (no legal amendment required beyond SOW addendum):
1) One-time top-up: customer prepays for X tokens equal to their 60-day elevated consumption. Top-up is pro-rated to co-term end.
2) Conditional uplift discount: 10% discount applied to the top-up if customer signs a 12-month co-term extension within 7 days.
3) Retroactive credit: allow credit application back to Oct 1 but cap to the top-up amount and mark as one-off accounting credit (Finance must approve; see note).
4) Staged voucher alternative: 50% usable immediately, 50% unlocks after 30 days if usage remains > baseline. No retroactive application for voucher path.
5) Priority capacity: offer a short-term priority burst window for queued jobs (value-add, operational) for the duration of the elevated period.

Risks & approvals: Finance needs to OK retroactive credit (we can route through credit memo). Sales leadership should approve up to 12% non-standard discount; any >12% requires director signoff.

I'll attach internal playbook notes. If team agrees, Priyom can send a numbers-backed proposal to Thermion with a DocuSign link for the SOW addendum.
